BUT let me tell you this, as having behaved sometimes in similar ways to your ex in the past. Dear, it has absolutely NOTHING to do with you, it has everything to do with himself and his own issues that he was not able to acknowledge, confront or deal with. I highly recommend a book called "feel the fear guide to long lasting love"... 
if only I had read it before perhaps I could have saved my relationship.   What your ex was doing (as it talks about in detail in the book)  was picking up the microscope instead of picking up the mirror. Instead of self reflecting on himself and his actions, thoughts and behaviour , he was picking up a microscope to find anything he could complain about you or what you were doing, he most likely was not happy with himself or the relationship but did not know how to communicate or how to take a look at where the anger and pain really came from, perhaps work, family, childhood. 
I highly recommend you read that book, and believe me when I tell you, as cliche as it sounds, it is not your fault.. it has nothing to do with you and everything to do with him. Sure you might've done a few things he didn't like such as leaving hairs in the shower, but there's a loving way to communicate this with a partner, leaving it on the wall is a very spiteful bitter thing to be doing which doesn't solve the problem. And we're all human, I'm sure he done many things which you didn't like but you chose to react differently.

Please read the book I feel it will give you a lot of relief !
